description: Named notice, warning and alert logs with independent rings and once-only subscriptions
author: Serg Parf

write.help: Store one entry, then synchronously forward each matching subscription before answering

args.name: log
args.help: Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters

args.name: text
args.help: One line, cleaned of controls and cut to 200 characters

read.help: Read live entries newest first; with no level, rings ordered alert, warning, notice

args.name: log
args.help: Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters

read.returns: {log,rings:{alert:[],warning:[],notice:[]},counts:{alert:n,warning:n,notice:n},latest_alert_at,now}; selected rings only, counts all levels; latest_alert_at null when no live alert

list.help: List active logs sorted by name, counts and latest live alert time

pull.help: Remove and return oldest entries; subscription inbox copies are unaffected

args.name: log
args.help: Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters

pull.returns: {log,entries:[],remaining,now}; oldest id first; removal durable before reply

clean.help: Remove entries up to id, or all entries; only an unbounded all-level clean retires the log

args.name: log
args.help: Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters

args.name: id
args.help: Entry upper id boundary, or subscription id for sub.delete

sub.add.help: Subscribe from now. One text selector always names a log, including alert; JSON can select only a level

args.name: target
args.help: Destination queue or agent; creator grants checked at add and every send

args.name: log
args.help: Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters

args.name: filter
args.help: Portable bare or /pattern/imsu regex, at most 200 scalar characters

sub.list.help: List creator subscriptions; direct Owner/Maintainers see all, including invalid_state repair rows

sub.delete.help: Delete your subscription; direct Owner/Maintainers may repair/delete any

args.name: id
args.help: Entry upper id boundary, or subscription id for sub.delete

rings.help: Level → optional size and ttl duration; defaults notice 200/1d, warning 200/7d, alert 50/30d; combined size <=500

logs.help: Log name → per-level ring overrides, same shape as rings
